notes: Import this into n8n, then: (1) create an 'OpenAi Api' credential and select it on every 'OpenAI ...' HTTP Request node, (2) set environment variables APP_BASE_URL and N8N_SCREENING_SECRET (must match the Next.js app's N8N_SCREENING_SECRET), (3) adjust the 'Batch Config' node for pilot testing (limit and/or explicit applicationIds).

This workflow only performs Stage 2 (AI Quality Evaluation) of Round 1. It assumes eligibility has already been determined upstream (currently a manual/known gap in the app — see docs/AI_Screening_Doc.md Section 6).
Writes go through app/api/screening/round1-result, never directly to Firestore, so validation/versioning/audit rules stay centralized in the app.

Runs Stage B (rubric scoring) twice independently per application and compares results, per the manual's evidence-first / consistency requirements. Divergent or low-confidence results are automatically flagged for manual review by the API route — they are never auto-approved.
